title: A continuous lattice avoids grain-boundary interruptions
caption: Crystal orientation describes the lattice direction presented to processing; a polished appearance alone does not imply a single crystal. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Single crystal
nodes.detail: One continuous lattice extends through the substrate.

nodes.label: Multiple grains
nodes.detail: Boundaries interrupt crystal order and can trap charge.

nodes.label: Oriented surface
nodes.detail: A specified crystal plane becomes the device-building surface.

title: From crystal pulling to semiconductor manufacturing
caption: The historical progression links a growth method, semiconductor adaptation and dislocation control rather than a sudden single invention. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Czochralski pulling
nodes.detail: A seed draws a crystal out of a melt.

nodes.label: Teal's semiconductor work
nodes.detail: Single-crystal material becomes central to electronics.

nodes.label: Dash necking
nodes.detail: A thin neck lets dislocations escape before body growth.

caption: The pull shaft extracts crystal while the heater, crucible and gas environment maintain growth conditions. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Pull shaft and seed
nodes.detail: Rotation and upward motion guide crystal growth.

nodes.label: Melt in quartz
nodes.detail: Liquid silicon sits inside a supported crucible.

nodes.label: Heater and insulation
nodes.detail: The hot zone shapes the temperature field.

nodes.label: Argon environment

title: Establish a clean crystal before growing the useful body
caption: Necking, shoulder formation and body growth serve different purposes; the final tail separates the crystal from the melt. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Melt and seed
nodes.detail: Prepare the melt and establish crystal contact.

nodes.label: Neck and shoulder
nodes.detail: Remove dislocations, then expand the diameter.

nodes.label: Constant-diameter body
nodes.detail: Maintain the useful crystal section.

nodes.label: Tail and cooldown
nodes.detail: Taper, detach and cool the grown ingot.

title: Growth rate and thermal gradient change the defect balance
caption: The v/G framework describes competing vacancy and interstitial populations; the figure does not define a universal operating threshold. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Vacancy-rich regime
nodes.detail: Missing lattice atoms can cluster during cooling.

nodes.label: Balance at the interface
nodes.detail: Pulling rate and temperature gradient act together.

nodes.label: Interstitial-rich regime
nodes.detail: Extra silicon atoms can also form extended defects.

title: Trace the impurity path through the hot zone
caption: Oxygen originates largely from quartz; carbon-containing hot-zone reactions provide another route into the growing crystal. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Quartz wall
nodes.detail: Contact with molten silicon introduces oxygen.

nodes.label: Graphite surroundings
nodes.detail: Hot-zone chemistry can introduce carbon-bearing species.

nodes.label: Gas transport
nodes.detail: Evaporation and convection redistribute species.

nodes.label: Growing interface
nodes.detail: A fraction of impurities becomes incorporated into the crystal.

title: A magnetic field calms an electrically conducting melt
caption: Magnetic control damps melt motion, influencing heat and impurity transport at the growth interface. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Conducting silicon melt
nodes.detail: Convection moves heat and dissolved impurities.

nodes.label: Applied magnetic field
nodes.detail: Electromagnetic forces oppose parts of the flow.

nodes.label: Growth interface
nodes.detail: A steadier environment helps control crystal uniformity.

title: One furnace cycle contains more than pulling time
caption: Charging, melting, growth and cooldown occupy equipment even when useful body length is not increasing. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Charge and melt
nodes.detail: Prepare liquid silicon and stabilize the hot zone.

nodes.label: Grow the body
nodes.detail: Useful cylinder length accumulates gradually.

nodes.label: Cool and unload
nodes.detail: The crystal must cool before handling.

nodes.label: Turn around the tool
nodes.detail: Prepare the chamber for the next run.

title: A massive body hangs through a narrow neck
caption: The thin neck removes dislocations during growth but becomes a mechanical load path as the ingot gets heavier. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Pulling mechanism
nodes.detail: The shaft carries the suspended load.

nodes.label: Dash neck
nodes.detail: The narrow section concentrates tensile stress.

nodes.label: Crystal body
nodes.detail: Increasing mass increases the supported weight.

title: Not every kilogram becomes a prime wafer
caption: The useful ingot body is only part of the original charge; geometry and electrical specifications both remove material. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Residual melt
nodes.detail: Some silicon remains in the crucible.

nodes.label: Crown and tail
nodes.detail: Growth-transition regions are cropped off.

nodes.label: Out-of-spec body
nodes.detail: Electrical or defect screening can reject sections.

nodes.label: Qualified cylinder
nodes.detail: Accepted material proceeds to slicing.

caption: An induction-heated liquid zone travels through a feed rod; surface tension holds the small molten region between solid sections. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Polycrystalline feed rod
nodes.detail: Solid feed supplies the moving molten zone.

nodes.label: Induction coil and zone
nodes.detail: Localized heating melts a narrow region.

nodes.label: Seeded crystal below
nodes.detail: Controlled solidification creates the single crystal.

caption: Area gains alone do not justify a diameter transition; compatible handling, process tools and investment must arrive together. Schematic, not to scale.

nodes.label: Larger substrate
nodes.detail: More surface area changes the cost-per-wafer opportunity.

nodes.label: Process equipment
nodes.detail: Chambers and processes require redesign and qualification.

nodes.label: Handling ecosystem

nodes.label: Industry adoption
